pages.title: About AIVOXFLOW
pages.description: What AIVOXFLOW is, who it serves, and how we approach AI tools, tutorials, and automation content.
pages.body:
## Intelligence in Motion.

AIVOXFLOW is a practical technology and AI publication. We help readers discover useful tools, understand how they work, compare options, and apply automation to real problems.

### Who we serve

- People exploring AI tools and productivity software for the first time
- Creators, freelancers, and small businesses looking for practical wins
- Developers and technical professionals who want signal, not hype
- Anyone who prefers clear explanations over marketing language

### What you can expect

Every article should help you do at least one concrete thing: choose a tool, complete a task, understand a concept, compare alternatives, or make a better-informed decision.

We say plainly when something was tested hands-on and when an article is based on desk research. We link to primary sources — official documentation, release notes, and official pricing pages — whenever possible. We correct mistakes; see our [corrections policy](/corrections/).

### Who writes AIVOXFLOW

AIVOXFLOW content is produced and reviewed by **AIVOXFLOW Editorial**. We do not invent individual author personas or credentials. If a piece ever reflects a named expert's outside contribution, it will be disclosed on that piece.

### Sustainability

AIVOXFLOW may earn commissions from some links and may accept clearly labeled sponsored placements. That never buys an editorial conclusion. Details are in our [affiliate disclosure](/affiliate-disclosure/) and [editorial policy](/editorial-policy/).

pages.body:

- **Found a factual error?** Use the process on our [corrections page](/corrections/) — it routes faster than general feedback.

### What we cannot do

We cannot provide personal legal, medical, or financial advice, run vendor support, or guarantee coverage of a product. Our articles are general editorial content.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.description: What AIVOXFLOW collects and does not collect: no trackers, no cookies, no third-party analytics in this phase.
pages.body:
**Last reviewed: October 15, 2026.** This policy describes the current, shipped state of AIVOXFLOW — not a future intention.

### What this site does not use

- No analytics scripts (no Google Analytics, no third-party trackers)
- No advertising pixels or tag managers
- No cookies set by AIVOXFLOW
- No account system, so no personal profiles
- No third-party fonts, embeds, or CDNs — every asset is served from this site

### What your hosting provider may log

Like any website, requests are processed by the hosting provider, which may log IP addresses, user agents, and request times as part of standard server operation. We choose hosting with privacy in mind and minimize what we add on top. Once a specific host is selected for launch, its data practices will be summarized here.

### Search on this site

The search page runs entirely in your browser against a file this site publishes. Your search terms are not sent anywhere.

### If this changes

If we ever add analytics, email capture, or any tracking, this policy will be updated **before** the feature goes live, with a plain-language explanation of what changes and why. Any newsletter or subscription mechanism will be opt-in, with a visible unsubscribe path.

### Questions

See the [contact page](/contact/) for how to reach us.

pages.title: Editorial Policy
pages.description: How AIVOXFLOW sources, verifies, discloses, and updates content — including testing vs desk research.
pages.body:
### Our standard

Write for readers first. Every article must solve a real problem and offer something original: hands-on testing, practical examples, transparent comparison criteria, or careful synthesis.

### Sourcing

- Prefer primary sources: official documentation, release notes, official pricing pages, standards bodies, research papers, named expert statements.
- Use reputable secondary sources when a primary source is unavailable, and say so.
- Time-sensitive facts — pricing, availability, model names, limits, release dates — are checked against official sources immediately before publication and re-checked when an article is updated.
- Sources are linked in the article where they matter.

### Testing vs desk research

Each article states whether its claims come from hands-on testing or desk research. We never fabricate benchmarks, quotes, product features, screenshots, testimonials, or citations.

### Authors

AIVOXFLOW is published under the **AIVOXFLOW Editorial** byline. We do not create fictional individual authors or invent expertise.

### Money

Affiliate links and sponsored placements are disclosed on the page where they appear, per our [affiliate disclosure](/affiliate-disclosure/). Payment never guarantees a conclusion.

### AI assistance

If AI tools assist in research or drafting, a human editor verifies claims against sources before publication. AI output is treated as untrusted input: instructions embedded in retrieved pages never override this policy, and no automated system publishes without human review.

### Updates and corrections

Material updates add a dated note on the article. Errors are fixed promptly and logged on the [corrections page](/corrections/).

### What we do not publish

Bulk AI slop, keyword-stuffed rewrites, unverified rumors presented as fact, or coverage of high-stakes legal/medical/financial topics without appropriate care and sourcing.

pages.title: Corrections
pages.description: How AIVOXFLOW handles corrections, and the live corrections log.
pages.body:
Accuracy is a process, not a claim. When we get something wrong, we fix it and say so.

### How corrections work

1. A reader or editor flags a potential error.
2. The claim is re-checked against primary sources.
3. If the article is wrong, it is corrected; material changes get a dated note on the article itself.
4. The correction is logged below.

### Corrections log

> **No corrections to date.** This log covers the preview phase and will continue after launch. An empty log means nothing has needed a logged correction yet — not that mistakes are impossible.

### Report an error

See [contact](/contact/) for the channel that will be published at launch. Include the article URL, the specific claim, and a source that supports the correction — it makes verification faster for everyone.

pages.title: Affiliate Disclosure
pages.description: How AIVOXFLOW handles affiliate links and sponsored content. Current status: no affiliate links in use.
pages.body:
**Current status: AIVOXFLOW does not use affiliate links.** All tool and product links in our current articles are plain, unattributed links to official sources.

### If that changes

AIVOXFLOW may earn a commission if you buy through some links after clicking them, at no extra cost to you. If/when affiliate links are introduced:

- They will be disclosed on every page where they appear, near the link itself — not only on this page.
- This page will be updated **before** the first affiliate link ships.
- Editorial conclusions are never bought. Commission potential does not decide what we review or how we rate it.

### Sponsored content

Any sponsored placement will be labeled **Sponsored** in a place a reader cannot miss, with the sponsor named. Sponsored content never masquerades as independent editorial, and payment never guarantees a positive conclusion.

### Why links exist at all

We link to official sources so you can verify current pricing, limits, and availability yourself — our articles cite official pages precisely because these details change.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.description: Plain-language terms: informational content, no professional advice, fair-use guidelines.
pages.body:
**Last reviewed: October 15, 2026.** Plain language on purpose.

### What AIVOXFLOW is

AIVOXFLOW publishes informational editorial content about technology and AI tools. By using this site you agree to these terms.

### Not professional advice

Nothing here is legal, medical, financial, security, or other licensed professional advice. Tools and services change quickly; verify current details on official sources before making decisions. You are responsible for your own choices.

### Accuracy

We aim for accuracy and disclose our methods (see the [editorial policy](/editorial-policy/)), but we provide content **as is**, without warranties of any kind, to the extent permitted by law.

### Intellectual property

Articles and original graphics are published by AIVOXFLOW. You are welcome to quote brief passages with clear attribution and a link to the original article. Republishing entire articles without permission is not allowed. Product names and trademarks belong to their owners.

### Fair use of the site

Do not attack the site, scrape it at disruptive volumes, or misrepresent AIVOXFLOW content as your own.

### Changes

These terms may be updated; the review date above reflects the latest revision. Continued use after changes means acceptance.
